summary: Iteration 9 Quill & Coffer follow-up enhancements verified end-to-end at 1920x800. Navbar fix and newspaper-style Front Page default tab both pass. All 7 frontpage cards render correctly with real or graceful empty-state content (no 'undefined'), all 7 jump-to-tab handlers work, and the back-to-frontpage flow re-renders the masthead cleanly.
critical_code_review_comments: QuillCofferFrontPage.js is well-structured and uses Promise.allSettled correctly so partial endpoint failures degrade gracefully — good defensive pattern.
Empty-state copy is consistent and friendly across all 5 teaser cards; no 'undefined' leaks observed even when rumors/bounties endpoints returned empty arrays.

Navbar.js uses whitespace-nowrap on every Link plus flex-wrap on the cluster — this keeps the brand on one line at 1920 but the link row still wraps under the brand when the viewport narrows enough; acceptable trade-off.

Sonner Toaster offset=80 plus top-right placement cleanly avoids the navbar; verified visually with the post-login 'Welcome back, traveler!' toast appearing in the top-right corner, not overlapping nav links.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seed (Chronicle, Ballads, Memorial populated; Rumors and Bounties empty as expected per preview env).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 verified: (1) Navbar brand 'Continents of Delarom' renders one line (height=32px) at 1920x800, no wrap. (2) Sonner Toaster confirmed data-y-position=top data-x-position=right with offset=80 — login welcome toast verified in top-right, NOT overlapping nav links. (3) /quill-and-coffer default tab is 'frontpage' with quill-tab-frontpage active and quill-panel-frontpage rendered containing data-testid='quill-frontpage'. (4) Masthead 'THE FRONT PAGE' + today's date present. (5) All 7 cards present: frontpage-card-chronicle (lead, real data 'Ausar Veltraus tried in wymroost…'), frontpage-card-rumors ('No rumors stir the taverns.' empty state), frontpage-card-bounties ('No warrants posted.' empty state), frontpage-card-memorial (real data 'In Memoriam: RetiredOne_…'), frontpage-card-ballads (real data 'Ausar's Mercy at Dusk'), frontpage-card-letters and frontpage-card-bonds (personal prompts). No 'undefined' anywhere. (6) Clicking each of the 7 cards correctly switches to its matching tab panel. (7) Clicking quill-tab-frontpage after navigating away re-renders the Front Page masthead. Nothing to fix.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found this iteration.
